verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents official SDKs/toolchain for building on Teams — Bot Framework SDK, Microsoft Graph API, Agents Toolkit CLI, and agent/app templates for creating bots, tabs, and message extensions, backed by a live, working Graph API endpoint and machine-readable OData schema. Missing for 10: independent third-party developer corroboration of SDK ergonomics/quality and an official OpenAPI/llms.txt spec (probes 404'd), which slightly limits AI-native discoverability.
